metas.name: 1 · ★ 7.9 · 2009 · Avatar
metas.description: A paraplegic Marine dispatched to the moon Pandora on a unique mission becomes torn between following his orders and protecting the world he feels is his home.

metas.name: 2 · ★ 7.5 · 2022 · Avatar: The Way of Water
metas.description: Jake Sully lives with his newfound family formed on the extrasolar moon Pandora. Once a familiar threat returns to finish what was previously started, Jake must work with Neytiri and the army of the Na'vi race to protect their home.

metas.name: 3 · ★ 7.2 · 2025 · Avatar: Fire and Ash
metas.description: Jake and Neytiri's family grapples with grief, encountering a new, aggressive Na'vi tribe, the Ash People, who are led by the fiery Varang, as the conflict on Pandora escalates and a new moral focus emerges.
